technical.summary: JNJ shows solid uptrend structure with price above all key MAs and strong momentum indicators, but lacks fresh entry triggers; MACD weakness and elevated RSI suggest caution on new longs despite bullish technicals.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, with elevated earnings risk in 91 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no conviction signal; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (395.68), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event 91 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and OBV rising volume confirm uptrend structure; extreme market fear (28/100) presents classic contrarian buy opportunity in defensive healthcare stock.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable with VIX at crisis levels (395.68), flat yield curve signalling recession, rising USD headwinds, and earnings binary risk in 91 days; MACD histogram negative, RSI elevated at 66, and no fresh entry triggers undermine conviction despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure remains bullish with price above all major MAs and supertrend confirmation, but macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, USD strength) combined with elevated earnings risk in 91 days and lack of fresh entry triggers make risk/reward unfavourable.
